candidate_windows.window_text: We use 8 NVIDIA Tesla P100 GPUs each with 16 GB memory to run our experiments. The hyperparameters used for each model are shown in Table 16. The best hyperparameters are highlighted in bold. Following the setting of Zhang et al. (2020), the arithmetic word problems from MAwPS are divided into five folds, each of equal test size. For ASDiv-A, we consider the 5-fold split [238, 238, 238, 238, 266] provided by the authors (Miao et al., 2020).
